about: Aetherfall world layout, generated by art/assets/islands.py from the web game's world.js. Unity space: metres, Y up; island content is relative to its island's position. Yaw is degrees about +Y.

conventions.fromWeb: three.js (x, y, z) -> Unity (-x, y, z); a model's rotation.y becomes Unity yaw -deg; the player's web yaw becomes 180 - deg.
conventions.scatterRow: [x, y, z, yawDegrees, uniformScale] plus [r, g, b] tint multipliers where the web tinted instances
conventions.edgeRadii: 360 walkable radii from the island centre, index = Unity atan2(z, x) in degrees; the web keeps a grounded player inside radius - 0.6.
conventions.fall: Below island centre y - 16 the player falls: return them to the last waystone (web: player.js vertical()).
